Comparison of F and NF Results
Indicator | F — content classified as fascist | NF — other content | Total
Number of posts | 42 | 78 | 120
Share of posts | 35% | 65% | 100%
Cumulative mER | 48.31 | 61.79 | 110.10
Share of cumulative mER | 44% | 56% | 100%
Mean mER per post (calculated from totals) | Approx. 1.15* | Approx. 0.79* | Approx. 0.92*
* The means in the final row are calculated from the reported sums and post counts: 48.31 / 42 ≈ 1.15; 61.79 / 78 ≈ 0.79; and 110.10 / 120 ≈ 0.92. In the narrative, the authors report a mean of 1.12 for F and 0.8 for NF. These figures do not fully match simple division of the table totals. This discrepancy should be noted in any subsequent scholarly use.
Analytical conclusion: F content accounted for 35% of posts but 44% of cumulative mER. This indicates relatively higher engagement as measured by mER. It does not establish that users approved of the content or that it changed their voting behavior.
The table was elaborated for the research project Civil Disorder in Pandemic-ridden European Union. The latter was financially supported by the National Science Centre, Poland [grant number 2021/43/B/HS5/00290].
